hills.name: Big SNOW American Dream
hills.getting_there: NJ Transit bus 355 from Port Authority Gate 305, under 30 minutes in normal traffic. Weekends and holidays hourly 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; weekdays 10 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. only.
kids: 6 and under: Little SNOW Day, 2 hours with rentals
Ages 5–12: Camp BIG, a 3-hour beginner program with rentals, helmet and jacket and pants
Snow play and tubing from age 3; 36 inches with an adult, 42 inches alone
price_rows: SNOW Day, ages 7+: 2 hours, rentals, jacket and pants, helmet
hills.price_note: The page names no season, and says Saturday, Sunday and holiday prices differ from these but doesn't show them. Gloves are $12 extra.

card_figure.small: + tax per person, 2 hours with rentals, non-holiday weekdays; weekend prices differ

hills.name: Mount Peter
hills.where: Warwick, NY · about an hour from NYC, the hill says
hills.getting_there: Drive; no public transit option on its page.
kids: Free beginner ski and snowboard lessons every day, the hill says (no details on what they include)
4 and under (Tiny Tots, one per adult): free midweek with an adult ticket; weekends priced below
Snow tubing; sessions on its tubing calendar
price_rows: Midweek all day, adult or junior
hills.price_note: 2026–27 rates. Rentals and helmets aren't included; Tiny Tot tickets are sold in person only.

card_figure.small: Saturday lift tickets, family of 4, estimate; rentals extra

hills.name: Mountain Creek
hills.getting_there: Drive; the general lot is free, closer lots cost extra (online only).
kids: 6 and under ski free with an adult Access Ticket (tickets are limited)
Kids Camp, ages 4–12: 2-hour lesson, rental and a full-day ticket (price not on its page)
Vern's Outdoor Park, 6 and under, 30-minute sessions on weekends (needs a day ticket)
price_rows: Go Package, ages 7+: full-day ticket, rental, self-guided learning area
hills.price_note: Lift tickets are sold online only and weren't showing prices on Nov 10. Closer parking lots are $20 and $50. The Go Package page names no season.

card_figure.small: + tax, Go Package per person, ages 7+: ticket and rental; no season named

hills.name: Thunder Ridge
hills.getting_there: One mile from Metro-North's Patterson station. The shuttle and the train-plus-ticket package have ended; it lists local taxis.
kids: Ski lessons from age 4; snowboard from 6
Weekend group lessons run 75 minutes: ages 4–7 on the lower mountain, skiing from 8 and snowboarding from 6
No rental helmets; buy one in its shop or bring your own
hills.price_note: 2026–27 lift prices weren't posted on Nov 10 (its page still shows last season). Lesson prices on its page have no season label, so we don't show them.

hills.name: Camelback
kids: 5 and under ski free (pick up the ticket at Guest Services with a birth certificate)
Snow tubing in 2-hour sessions: 33–43 inches in a double tube with an adult, 44 inches alone
Kids Camp listed for ages 4–14 who already ski blue runs (last season's listing)
hills.price_note: Its ticket pages showed no day prices on Nov 10; check its online store for your date.

hills.name: Hunter Mountain
kids: Child group lessons for ages 7–14; younger kids go in smaller groups by ability
Kids must be potty trained; helmets required and not rented
Does not take the SKI NY Kids Passport
hills.price_note: Prices change by date; its lessons page shows none. Epic Pass holders save 20% on group lessons, it says.

hills.name: Belleayre
kids: Takes the SKI NY Kids Passport any day, holidays included
Kids group lessons for ages 4–12 were listed last season; 2026–27 not posted
hills.price_note: 2026–27 day prices weren't on its pages on Nov 10.

passes.name: SKI NY Kids Passport
passes.gives: Free lift tickets with a paying adult, up to 2 uses at each participating hill, Dec 1, 2026 to May 1, 2027. No rentals or lessons.
passes.fee_priced: $45 processing fee (its page says per application; its FAQ says per child), no refunds.
passes.how: Apply at app.junipass.com with a photo and proof of grade; the passport is emailed by Thanksgiving week.
passes.limits: Near NYC: Belleayre any day (parent's ticket from its website, or a season pass); Thunder Ridge, Plattekill not on holidays; Windham, Big SNOW, Mountain Creek non-holiday weekdays only (last two: arrange ahead). Hunter doesn't take it.

passes.name: PA Outdoor Adventure Pass
passes.gives: A lift ticket or lesson deal at each participating Pennsylvania hill, set by the hill (not free tickets), plus outdoor deals all year, valid through August 2027.
passes.how: Buy online with photos of your child and you and proof of grade; grade checks take 1–3 business days.
passes.limits: Near NYC: Camelback, Blue Mountain and Shawnee Mountain; each sets its own offer and blackout dates.
